blocks.original_text:
- name: lever__candidate_experience_insights
      description: Candidate experience metrics and scores per opportunity derived from lifecycle, interview, communication, and outcome signals
      grain: One row per opportunity_id
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_lever__candidate_lifecycle
      - staging.stg_lever__opportunity
      - staging.stg_lever__stage
      - staging.stg_lever__archive_reason
      - intermediate.int_lever__contact_info
      business_logic: 'Build candidate_journey by joining: - intermediate.int_lever__candidate_lifecycle (cl) to staging.stg_lever__opportunity (o) on opportunity_id, left join intermediate.int_lever__contact_info (c) on contact_id, join staging.stg_lever__stage (s) on o.stage_id, and left join staging.stg_lever__archive_reason (ar) on o.archived_reason_id. - Derive fields: - activity_status: constant ''Active''. - lifecycle_speed_category: total_lifecycle_days bucketed as ≤14 ''Fast'', ≤30 ''Standard'', ≤60 ''Slow'', else ''Very Slow''. - interview_completion_rate_pct: completed_interviews divided by total_interviews times 100, rounded to 1 decimal; no explicit zero-division guard; NULLs propagate. - Carry through totals (interviews, completed, canceled), avg_interview_duration_minutes, total_interview_time_minutes, avg_recommendation_score, feedback_completion_rate_pct, is_archived, application_date (o.created_at), last_interaction_at, last_advanced_at, current_stage (s.stage_name), archive_reason (ar.archive_reason_title). Compute communication_quality per opportunity_id: - days_from_application_to_last_contact: difference in days between last_interaction_at and application_date; NULL if either is NULL. - days_from_application_to_last_advancement: difference in days between last_advanced_at and application_date; NULL if either is NULL. - response_quality from days_since_last_advancement: ≤1 ''Excellent Response (≤1 day)''; ≤3 ''Good Response (2-3 days)''; ≤7 ''Moderate Response (4-7 days)''; ≤14 ''Slow Response (8-14 days)''; else ''Very Slow Response (>14 days)'' (NULL falls to the else bucket). - transparency_score from feedback_completion_rate_pct: ≥90→5; ≥70→4; ≥50→3; ≥30→2; else 1 (NULL falls to 1). Compute interview_experience per opportunity_id: - interview_experience_score: - If total_interviews = 0 → NULL. - Else if completion rate ≥95 and avg duration in 30–90 minutes → 5. - Else if completion rate ≥80 and avg duration in 20–120 minutes → 4. - Else if completion rate ≥60 → 3; else if ≥40 → 2; else → 1. - interview_burden_category: - If total_interviews = 0 → ''No Interviews''. - Else if total_interviews ≤2 and total_interview_time_minutes ≤120 → ''Light Process''; ≤4 and ≤240 → ''Standard Process''; ≤6 and ≤360 → ''Intensive Process''; else ''Heavy Process''. - interview_consistency_score: - If total_interviews = 0 → NULL. - Else if canceled_interviews = 0 → 5; else if canceled/total ≤10% → 4; ≤20% → 3; ≤30% → 2; else → 1. Compute outcome_fairness per opportunity_id: - outcome_fairness_score: - If not archived → NULL. - Else 5 for stage indicating hire/accept or reason indicating withdrew/declined; 4 for offer stage or skills/qualification mismatch; 3 for culture fit issues or other; 2 if rejected without a stated reason. - process_completeness_assessment: - If not archived → ''In Progress''; else if avg_recommendation_score ≥4 and stage does not indicate hire → ''Potential Mismatch''; else if avg_recommendation_score ≤2 → ''Consistent Outcome''; else if avg_recommendation_score is NULL → ''Incomplete Process''; else → ''Normal Process''. Compute timeline_experience per opportunity_id: - timeline_experience_score compares lifecycle_speed_category to labels ''Fast Track (≤7 days)'', ''Normal (8-30 days)'', ''Extended (31-60 days)'', ''Long Process (>60 days)''; because candidate_journey uses ''Fast''/''Standard''/''Slow''/''Very Slow'', no label matches and the else branch applies, yielding 1 for all rows. - candidate_anxiety_level from activity_status: ''Active'' maps to ''Low Anxiety''. Final projection and derived fields: - overall_candidate_experience_score: weighted average of subscores (transparency 20%, interview experience 25%, interview consistency 15%, outcome fairness 20%, timeline 20%), defaulting missing subscores to 3, rounded to 1 decimal. - experience_grade from the same rounded overall score: ≥4.5 ''Exceptional Experience''; ≥4.0 ''Excellent Experience''; ≥3.5 ''Good Experience''; ≥3.0 ''Average Experience''; ≥2.0 ''Below Average Experience''; else ''Poor Experience''. - improvement_recommendations: concatenate in this order (each fragment ends with ''; '' and no trimming): if transparency_score ≤2 add ''Improve feedback transparency; ''; if interview_experience_score ≤2 add ''Optimize interview process; ''; if timeline_experience_score ≤2 add ''Accelerate decision timeline; ''; if days_since_last_advancement ≥14 add ''Increase communication frequency; ''. - experience_risk_flag (first match): if days_since_last_advancement ≥21 and not archived → ''High Abandonment Risk''; else if canceled_interviews ≥2 → ''Poor Interview Experience''; else if transparency_score ≤2 and total_interviews ≥3 → ''Low Process Transparency''; else if timeline_experience_score ≤2 and total_lifecycle_days ≥60 → ''Extended Timeline Concern''; else ''Normal''. - calculated_at = current timestamp at model execution. - Final result ordered by overall_candidate_experience_score descending, then total_lifecycle_days ascending.'
      columns:
      - name: opportunity_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Primary key opportunity identifier; one output row per opportunity_id
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: contact_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Candidate contact identifier from lifecycle data
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: contact_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Candidate name from opportunity data
      - name: current_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Current pipeline stage name from stage reference
      - name: application_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Opportunity creation timestamp used as application date
      - name: total_lifecycle_days
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total elapsed days the opportunity has been active
      - name: is_archived
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Archive status from lifecycle (0=active, 1=archived) used as boolean in case logic
      - name: archive_reason
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Archive reason title from archive reason reference; may be NULL
      - name: response_quality
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Bucket by days_since_last_advancement: ≤1 Excellent, 2–3 Good, 4–7 Moderate, 8–14 Slow, >14 Very Slow; NULLs fall to Very Slow'
      - name: transparency_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: '1–5 based on feedback_completion_rate_pct: ≥90→5, ≥70→4, ≥50→3, ≥30→2, else 1; NULLs fall to 1'
      - name: interview_experience_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 1–5 using completion rate and average duration; total_interviews=0→NULL; ≥95% and 30–90min→5; ≥80% and 20–120min→4; ≥60%→3; ≥40%→2; else 1
      - name: interview_burden_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Interview load by count and total time: No Interviews; Light (≤2 and ≤120); Standard (≤4 and ≤240); Intensive (≤6 and ≤360); else Heavy'
      - name: interview_consistency_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 1–5 by cancellation ratio; total_interviews=0→NULL; 0 cancels→5; ≤10%→4; ≤20%→3; ≤30%→2; else 1
      - name: outcome_fairness_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: '1–5 only if archived: 5 for hire/accept or withdrew/declined, 4 for offer or skills mismatch, 3 for culture/other, 2 if rejected without reason; active→NULL'
      - name: process_completeness_assessment
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Assessment: In Progress, Potential Mismatch, Consistent Outcome, Incomplete Process, or Normal Process based on archived status and avg_recommendation_score'
      - name: timeline_experience_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Intended 1–5 from lifecycle speed label comparison; due to label mismatch it defaults to 1 for all rows
      - name: candidate_anxiety_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Derived from activity_status; constant 'Active' maps to 'Low Anxiety'
      - name: total_interviews
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Total scheduled interviews from lifecycle data
      - name: interview_completion_rate_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Completed_interviews/total_interviews*100 rounded to 1 decimal; no explicit zero-division guard; NULLs propagate
      - name: avg_interview_duration_minutes
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Average interview duration in minutes from lifecycle data
      - name: feedback_completion_rate_pct
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Percent of interviews with submitted feedback (integer percent) from lifecycle data
      - name: avg_recommendation_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Average interviewer recommendation (integer scale) from lifecycle data
      - name: days_since_last_advancement
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Days since the opportunity last advanced stage from lifecycle data
      - name: days_from_application_to_last_contact
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Days between application_date and last_interaction_at; NULL if either timestamp is NULL
      - name: days_from_application_to_last_advancement
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Days between application_date and last_advanced_at; NULL if either timestamp is NULL
      - name: overall_candidate_experience_score
        data_type: DECIMAL(17,1)
        description: Weighted subscore average (20% transparency, 25% interview experience, 15% consistency, 20% fairness, 20% timeline), missing subscores default to 3, rounded to 1 decimal
      - name: experience_grade
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Grade from the rounded overall score: ≥4.5 Exceptional, ≥4.0 Excellent, ≥3.5 Good, ≥3.0 Average, ≥2.0 Below Average, else Poor'
      - name: improvement_recommendations
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Concatenation of advisory fragments (fixed order, each ends with '; ') for triggered conditions; empty string if none
      - name: experience_risk_flag
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Precedence: High Abandonment Risk, Poor Interview Experience, Low Process Transparency, Extended Timeline Concern, else Normal'
      - name: calculated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Execution timestamp set at model run time

CASE WHEN cl.feedback_completion_rate_pct >= 90 THEN 5 WHEN cl.feedback_completion_rate_pct >= 70 THEN 4 WHEN cl.feedback_completion_rate_pct >= 50 THEN 3 WHEN cl.feedback_completion_rate_pct >= 30 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END

CASE WHEN cl.total_interviews = 0 THEN NULL WHEN cl.completed_interviews * 100.0 / NULLIF(cl.total_interviews, 0) >= 95 AND cl.avg_interview_duration_minutes BETWEEN 30 AND 90 THEN 5 WHEN cl.completed_interviews * 100.0 / NULLIF(cl.total_interviews, 0) >= 80 AND cl.avg_interview_duration_minutes BETWEEN 20 AND 120 THEN 4 WHEN cl.completed_interviews * 100.0 / NULLIF(cl.total_interviews, 0) >= 60 THEN 3 WHEN cl.completed_interviews * 100.0 / NULLIF(cl.total_interviews, 0) >= 40 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END

CASE WHEN total_interviews = 0 THEN 'No Interviews' WHEN total_interviews <= 2 AND total_interview_time_minutes <= 120 THEN 'Light Process' WHEN total_interviews <= 4 AND total_interview_time_minutes <= 240 THEN 'Standard Process' WHEN total_interviews <= 6 AND total_interview_time_minutes <= 360 THEN 'Intensive Process' ELSE 'Heavy Process' END

CASE WHEN cl.total_interviews = 0 THEN NULL WHEN cl.canceled_interviews = 0 THEN 5 WHEN cl.canceled_interviews * 1.0 / cl.total_interviews <= 0.1 THEN 4 WHEN cl.canceled_interviews * 1.0 / cl.total_interviews <= 0.2 THEN 3 WHEN cl.canceled_interviews * 1.0 / cl.total_interviews <= 0.3 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END

CASE WHEN is_archived = 0 THEN NULL WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(current_stage, '')) LIKE '%hire%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(current_stage, '')) LIKE '%accept%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(archive_reason, '')) LIKE '%withdraw%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(archive_reason, '')) LIKE '%declin%' THEN 5 WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(current_stage, '')) LIKE '%offer%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(archive_reason, '')) LIKE '%skill%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(archive_reason, '')) LIKE '%qualification%' THEN 4 WHEN archive_reason IS NULL THEN 2 ELSE 3 END

CASE WHEN is_archived = 0 THEN 'In Progress' WHEN avg_recommendation_score >= 4 AND LOWER(COALESCE(current_stage, '')) NOT LIKE '%hire%' THEN 'Potential Mismatch' WHEN avg_recommendation_score <= 2 THEN 'Consistent Outcome' WHEN avg_recommendation_score IS NULL THEN 'Incomplete Process' ELSE 'Normal Process' END

CASE WHEN ROUND((COALESCE(transparency_score, 3) * 0.2 + COALESCE(interview_experience_score, 3) * 0.25 + COALESCE(interview_consistency_score, 3) * 0.15 + COALESCE(outcome_fairness_score, 3) * 0.2 + 3 * 0.2), 1) >= 4.5 THEN 'Exceptional Experience' WHEN ROUND((COALESCE(transparency_score, 3) * 0.2 + COALESCE(interview_experience_score, 3) * 0.25 + COALESCE(interview_consistency_score, 3) * 0.15 + COALESCE(outcome_fairness_score, 3) * 0.2 + 3 * 0.2), 1) >= 4 THEN 'Excellent Experience' WHEN ROUND((COALESCE(transparency_score, 3) * 0.2 + COALESCE(interview_experience_score, 3) * 0.25 + COALESCE(interview_consistency_score, 3) * 0.15 + COALESCE(outcome_fairness_score, 3) * 0.2 + 3 * 0.2), 1) >= 3.5 THEN 'Good Experience' WHEN ROUND((COALESCE(transparency_score, 3) * 0.2 + COALESCE(interview_experience_score, 3) * 0.25 + COALESCE(interview_consistency_score, 3) * 0.15 + COALESCE(outcome_fairness_score, 3) * 0.2 + 3 * 0.2), 1) >= 3 THEN 'Average Experience' WHEN ROUND((COALESCE(transparency_score, 3) * 0.2 + COALESCE(interview_experience_score, 3) * 0.25 + COALESCE(interview_consistency_score, 3) * 0.15 + COALESCE(outcome_fairness_score, 3) * 0.2 + 3 * 0.2), 1) >= 2 THEN 'Below Average Experience' ELSE 'Poor Experience' END

CASE WHEN days_since_last_advancement >= 21 AND is_archived = 0 THEN 'High Abandonment Risk' WHEN canceled_interviews >= 2 THEN 'Poor Interview Experience' WHEN transparency_score <= 2 AND total_interviews >= 3 THEN 'Low Process Transparency' WHEN total_lifecycle_days >= 60 THEN 'Extended Timeline Concern' ELSE 'Normal' END

references.name: intermediate.int_lever__candidate_lifecycle
references.line_text: business_logic: 'Build candidate_journey by joining: - intermediate.int_lever__candidate_lifecycle (cl) to staging.stg_lever__opportunity (o) on opportunity_id, left join intermediate.int_lever__contact_info (c) on contact_id, join staging.stg_lever__stage (s) on o.stage_id, and left join staging.stg_lever__archive_reason (ar) on o.archived_reason_id. - Derive fields: - activity_status: constant ''Active''. - lifecycle_speed_category: total_lifecycle_days bucketed as ≤14 ''Fast'', ≤30 ''Standard'', ≤60 ''Slow'', else ''Very Slow''. - interview_completion_rate_pct: completed_interviews divided by total_interviews times 100, rounded to 1 decimal; no explicit zero-division guard; NULLs propagate. - Carry through totals (interviews, completed, canceled), avg_interview_duration_minutes, total_interview_time_minutes, avg_recommendation_score, feedback_completion_rate_pct, is_archived, application_date (o.created_at), last_interaction_at, last_advanced_at, current_stage (s.stage_name), archive_reason (ar.archive_reason_title). Compute communication_quality per opportunity_id: - days_from_application_to_last_contact: difference in days between last_interaction_at and application_date; NULL if either is NULL. - days_from_application_to_last_advancement: difference in days between last_advanced_at and application_date; NULL if either is NULL. - response_quality from days_since_last_advancement: ≤1 ''Excellent Response (≤1 day)''; ≤3 ''Good Response (2-3 days)''; ≤7 ''Moderate Response (4-7 days)''; ≤14 ''Slow Response (8-14 days)''; else ''Very Slow Response (>14 days)'' (NULL falls to the else bucket). - transparency_score from feedback_completion_rate_pct: ≥90→5; ≥70→4; ≥50→3; ≥30→2; else 1 (NULL falls to 1). Compute interview_experience per opportunity_id: - interview_experience_score: - If total_interviews = 0 → NULL. - Else if completion rate ≥95 and avg duration in 30–90 minutes → 5. - Else if completion rate ≥80 and avg duration in 20–120 minutes → 4. - Else if completion rate ≥60 → 3; else if ≥40 → 2; else → 1. - interview_burden_category: - If total_interviews = 0 → ''No Interviews''. - Else if total_interviews ≤2 and total_interview_time_minutes ≤120 → ''Light Process''; ≤4 and ≤240 → ''Standard Process''; ≤6 and ≤360 → ''Intensive Process''; else ''Heavy Process''. - interview_consistency_score: - If total_interviews = 0 → NULL. - Else if canceled_interviews = 0 → 5; else if canceled/total ≤10% → 4; ≤20% → 3; ≤30% → 2; else → 1. Compute outcome_fairness per opportunity_id: - outcome_fairness_score: - If not archived → NULL. - Else 5 for stage indicating hire/accept or reason indicating withdrew/declined; 4 for offer stage or skills/qualification mismatch; 3 for culture fit issues or other; 2 if rejected without a stated reason. - process_completeness_assessment: - If not archived → ''In Progress''; else if avg_recommendation_score ≥4 and stage does not indicate hire → ''Potential Mismatch''; else if avg_recommendation_score ≤2 → ''Consistent Outcome''; else if avg_recommendation_score is NULL → ''Incomplete Process''; else → ''Normal Process''. Compute timeline_experience per opportunity_id: - timeline_experience_score compares lifecycle_speed_category to labels ''Fast Track (≤7 days)'', ''Normal (8-30 days)'', ''Extended (31-60 days)'', ''Long Process (>60 days)''; because candidate_journey uses ''Fast''/''Standard''/''Slow''/''Very Slow'', no label matches and the else branch applies, yielding 1 for all rows. - candidate_anxiety_level from activity_status: ''Active'' maps to ''Low Anxiety''. canceled_interviews>=2 THEN 'Poor Interview Experience' WHEN transparency_score<=2 AND total_interviews>=3 THEN 'Low Process Transparency' WHEN total_lifecycle_days>=60 THEN 'Extended Timeline business_logic: 'Build candidate_journey by joining: - intermediate.int_lever__candidate_lifecycle (cl) to staging.stg_lever__opportunity (o) on opportunity_id, left join intermediate.int_lever__contact_info (c) on contact_id, join staging.stg_lever__stage (s) on o.stage_id, and left join staging.stg_lever__archive_reason (ar) on o.archived_reason_id. - Derive fields: - activity_status: constant ''Active''. - lifecycle_speed_category: total_lifecycle_days bucketed as ≤14 ''Fast'', ≤30 ''Standard'', ≤60 ''Slow'', else ''Very Slow''. - interview_completion_rate_pct: completed_interviews divided by total_interviews times 100, rounded to 1 decimal; no explicit zero-division guard; NULLs propagate. - Carry through totals (interviews, completed, canceled), avg_interview_duration_minutes, total_interview_time_minutes, avg_recommendation_score, feedback_completion_rate_pct, is_archived, application_date (o.created_at), last_interaction_at, last_advanced_at, current_stage (s.stage_name), archive_reason (ar.archive_reason_title). Compute communication_quality per opportunity_id: - days_from_application_to_last_contact: difference in days between last_interaction_at and application_date; NULL if either is NULL. - days_from_application_to_last_advancement: difference in days between last_advanced_at and application_date; NULL if either is NULL. - response_quality from days_since_last_advancement: ≤1 ''Excellent Response (≤1 day)''; ≤3 ''Good Response (2-3 days)''; ≤7 ''Moderate Response (4-7 days)''; ≤14 ''Slow Response (8-14 days)''; else ''Very Slow Response (>14 days)'' (NULL falls to the else bucket). - transparency_score from feedback_completion_rate_pct: ≥90→5; ≥70→4; ≥50→3; ≥30→2; else 1 (NULL falls to 1). Compute interview_experience per opportunity_id: - interview_experience_score: - If total_interviews = 0 → NULL. - Else if completion rate ≥95 and avg duration in 30–90 minutes → 5. - Else if completion rate ≥80 and avg duration in 20–120 minutes → 4. - Else if completion rate ≥60 → 3; else if ≥40 → 2; else → 1. - interview_burden_category: - If total_interviews = 0 → ''No Interviews''. - Else if total_interviews ≤2 and total_interview_time_minutes ≤120 → ''Light Process''; ≤4 and ≤240 → ''Standard Process''; ≤6 and ≤360 → ''Intensive Process''; else ''Heavy Process''. - interview_consistency_score: - If total_interviews = 0 → NULL. - Else if canceled_interviews = 0 → 5; else if canceled/total ≤10% → 4; ≤20% → 3; ≤30% → 2; else → 1. Compute outcome_fairness per opportunity_id: - outcome_fairness_score: - If not archived → NULL. - Else 5 for stage indicating hire/accept or reason indicating withdrew/declined; 4 for offer stage or skills/qualification mismatch; 3 for culture fit issues or other; 2 if rejected without a stated reason. - process_completeness_assessment: - If not archived → ''In Progress''; else if avg_recommendation_score ≥4 and stage does not indicate hire → ''Potential Mismatch''; else if avg_recommendation_score ≤2 → ''Consistent Outcome''; else if avg_recommendation_score is NULL → ''Incomplete Process''; else → ''Normal Process''. Compute timeline_experience per opportunity_id: - timeline_experience_score compares lifecycle_speed_category to labels ''Fast Track (≤7 days)'', ''Normal (8-30 days)'', ''Extended (31-60 days)'', ''Long Process (>60 days)''; because candidate_journey uses ''Fast''/''Standard''/''Slow''/''Very Slow'', no label matches and the else branch applies, yielding 1 for all rows. - candidate_anxiety_level from activity_status: ''Active'' maps to ''Low Anxiety''. Final projection and derived fields: - overall_candidate_experience_score: weighted average of subscores (transparency 20%, interview experience 25%, interview consistency 15%, outcome fairness 20%, timeline 20%), defaulting missing subscores to 3, rounded to 1 decimal. - experience_grade from the same rounded overall score: ≥4.5 ''Exceptional Experience''; ≥4.0 ''Excellent Experience''; ≥3.5 ''Good Experience''; ≥3.0 ''Average Experience''; ≥2.0 ''Below Average Experience''; else ''Poor Experience''. - improvement_recommendations: concatenate in this order (each fragment ends with ''; '' and no trimming): if transparency_score ≤2 add ''Improve feedback transparency; ''; if interview_experience_score ≤2 add ''Optimize interview process; ''; if timeline_experience_score ≤2 add ''Accelerate decision timeline; ''; if days_since_last_advancement ≥14 add ''Increase communication frequency; ''. - experience_risk_flag (first match): if days_since_last_advancement ≥21 and not archived → ''High Abandonment Risk''; else if canceled_interviews ≥2 → ''Poor Interview Experience''; else if transparency_score ≤2 and total_interviews ≥3 → ''Low Process Transparency''; else if timeline_experience_score ≤2 and total_lifecycle_days ≥60 → ''Extended Timeline Concern''; else ''Normal''. - calculated_at = current timestamp at model execution. - Final result ordered by overall_candidate_experience_score descending, then total_lifecycle_days ascending.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: lever__candidate_quality_insights
      description: Single-row snapshot computed at run time summarizing candidate quality distributions, percentiles, and top contributing factors.
      grain: Exactly one row per run (point-in-time snapshot)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_lever__candidate_insights (opportunity_id, candidate_quality_score, total_lifecycle_days, total_interviews, interview_completion_rate, positive_feedback_rate, candidate_status_category, candidate_experience_quality, current_stage_order)
      - staging.stg_lever__application (opportunity_id, posting_id, referrer_user_id, type)
      - staging.stg_lever__posting (posting_id, categories_department, categories_team, categories_location, categories_level)
      business_logic: '1) Build candidate_base: - Join candidate insights to applications on opportunity_id, then to postings on posting_id. - Retain fields needed for segmentation and aggregation (quality score, lifecycle days, interviews, completion rate, feedback rate, status, experience quality, stage order, posting_id, referrer_user_id, application type, department, team, location, level). 2) Derive per-candidate attributes (quality_segments): - quality_segment: score >=80 → "Exceptional (80+)", 60–79 → "High Quality (60-79)", 40–59 → "Good Quality (40-59)", 20–39 → "Basic Quality (20-39)", otherwise → "Low Quality (<20)" (NULL scores fall into the last bucket). - funnel_stage_group: stage order >=5 → "Offer/Hire Stage"; >=3 → "Advanced Interview Stage"; >=2 → "Initial Interview Stage"; otherwise → "Early Stage". - source_type: referrer present → "Referred"; else if application type = ''user'' → "Internal"; otherwise → "External". 3) Compute top_quality_indicators: - Independently for Source Type, Department (non-NULL), and Job Level (non-NULL), calculate the average quality score per group and its sample size. - Only consider groups with at least five candidates; rank groups by descending average quality; the best group is rank 1. If multiple groups tie for top rank, selecting a single best group is ambiguous and may fail. 4) Final summary (single row): - analysis_date and generated_at capture the run date and timestamp; report_title is a fixed string. - Totals: total_candidates_analyzed is the count of all segmented candidates; segment counts are the number of candidates in each quality bucket. - Score metrics: overall average, median (50th percentile), and 75th percentile of quality score, each rounded to one decimal; NULL scores are ignored; if no valid values, results are NULL. - Best factors: for each factor type, take the top-ranked group (with at least five candidates) as the best_* fields; corresponding average quality is rounded to one decimal; if no qualifying group, values are NULL. - Process metrics by quality: high-quality groups = Exceptional and High Quality; low-quality groups = Basic Quality and Low Quality. • Average lifecycle days for each group set, rounded to one decimal; NULLs ignored; NULL if no qualifying values. • Interview completion rate averages for each group set, rounded to one decimal; NULLs ignored; NULL if none. - key_finding_source: if the average score for Referred exceeds External by more than 10, recommend referrals; else if Internal exceeds External by more than 10, highlight internal mobility; otherwise note no significant source difference. Any NULL average prevents a match. - key_finding_overall: share of high/exceptional candidates (count of those groups divided by all candidates) drives messaging: ≥40% → "Strong", ≥25% → "Good", otherwise → "Opportunity". - primary_recommendation: driven by the best source type (Referred → invest in referrals; Internal → promote mobility; otherwise optimize external channels). - process_recommendation: compare rounded average lifecycle days between high- and low-quality groups; if high-quality is faster, recommend fast-tracking; otherwise recommend improving early screening. If either average is NULL, the comparison does not match and defaults to the latter. 5) Notes: - Aggregations cover all joined candidates without date partitioning or de-duplication beyond the joins. - Other derived summaries not referenced in the final output do not affect results.'
      columns:
      - name: analysis_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Run date captured at execution time.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: generated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Run timestamp captured at execution time.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: report_title
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Fixed title: ''Candidate Quality Intelligence Report''.'
      - name: total_candidates_analyzed
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total number of segmented candidates after joins.
      - name: exceptional_candidates
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of candidates with score ≥80.
      - name: high_quality_candidates
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of candidates with score 60–79.
      - name: good_quality_candidates
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of candidates with score 40–59.
      - name: basic_quality_candidates
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of candidates with score 20–39.
      - name: low_quality_candidates
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of candidates with score <20 or NULL.
      - name: overall_avg_quality_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average quality score rounded to 1 decimal; NULLs ignored; NULL if none.
      - name: median_quality_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 50th percentile of quality score rounded to 1 decimal; NULLs ignored; NULL if none.
      - name: p75_quality_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 75th percentile of quality score rounded to 1 decimal; NULLs ignored; NULL if none.
      - name: best_source_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Top source type by average score among groups with ≥5 candidates; ties unresolved; NULL if none.
      - name: best_source_avg_quality
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average quality score for the best source type rounded to 1 decimal; NULL if best_source_type is NULL.
      - name: best_department
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Top department (non-NULL) by average score among groups with ≥5 candidates; ties unresolved; NULL if none.
      - name: best_department_avg_quality
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average quality score for the best department rounded to 1 decimal; NULL if best_department is NULL.
      - name: best_job_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Top job level (non-NULL) by average score among groups with ≥5 candidates; ties unresolved; NULL if none.
      - name: best_job_level_avg_quality
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average quality score for the best job level rounded to 1 decimal; NULL if best_job_level is NULL.
      - name: high_quality_avg_lifecycle_days
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average lifecycle days for Exceptional/High Quality rounded to 1 decimal; NULLs ignored; NULL if none.
      - name: low_quality_avg_lifecycle_days
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average lifecycle days for Basic/Low Quality rounded to 1 decimal; NULLs ignored; NULL if none.
      - name: high_quality_interview_completion_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average interview completion rate for Exceptional/High Quality rounded to 1 decimal; NULLs ignored; NULL if none.
      - name: low_quality_interview_completion_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average interview completion rate for Basic/Low Quality rounded to 1 decimal; NULLs ignored; NULL if none.
      - name: key_finding_source
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Message based on source-type averages: Referred or Internal exceeding External by >10 triggers respective message; otherwise note no significant difference.'
      - name: key_finding_overall
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Message based on the share of high/exceptional candidates: ≥40% Strong, ≥25% Good, otherwise Opportunity.'
      - name: primary_recommendation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Recommendation driven by best source type: Referred → invest in referrals; Internal → promote mobility; otherwise optimize external channels.'
      - name: process_recommendation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Recommendation from comparing rounded average lifecycle days: if high-quality is faster, fast-track; otherwise improve early screening.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: lever__departmental_hiring_trends
      description: Department- and team-level hiring metrics replicated across posting slices using Lever staging and intermediate joins
      grain: One row per posting in staging.stg_lever__posting multiplied by the count of application_volume rows for the same department+team (department/team-level aggregates replicated across each posting’s department/team/location/level/commitment_type)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_lever__posting
      - staging.stg_lever__application
      - staging.stg_lever__opportunity
      - staging.stg_lever__stage
      - intermediate.int_lever__candidate_lifecycle
      - staging.stg_lever__interview
      - staging.stg_lever__interviewer_user
      - staging.stg_lever__interview_feedback
      - marts.lever__candidate_experience_insights
      - intermediate.int_lever__hiring_funnel_metrics
      business_logic: '- Build department_posting_base from postings: - Dimensions defaulted via COALESCE: department=''Unknown Department'', team=''Unknown Team'', location=''Unknown Location'', level=''Unknown Level'', commitment_type=''Unknown Commitment''. - Keep posting_id and timestamps; derive posting_month and posting_quarter by truncating created_at. - application_volume (dept+team+location+level+commitment_type+month+quarter): - Distinct counts: applications, candidates, opportunities, postings; referred applications where referrer_user_id is present. - referral_rate = referred applications / total applications * 100, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when no applications. - avg_applications_per_posting = total applications / active postings, rounded to 1 decimal; NULL when active postings=0 (later COALESCE to 0). - hiring_outcomes (dept+team): - candidates_hired: distinct opportunities with stage name containing ''hire'' or ''accept''; offers_extended: distinct opportunities with stage name containing ''offer''. - Averages for hired/accepted only: time_to_hire (lifecycle days) and interviews_per_hire. - hire_conversion_rate = candidates_hired / distinct opportunities * 100, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when no opportunities. - offer_acceptance_rate = candidates_hired / offers_extended * 100, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when no offers. - interview_metrics (dept+team): - total_interviews_conducted: distinct interviews; completed when not canceled; canceled when canceled. - unique_interviewers: distinct interviewer users; avg_interview_duration: average interview duration (minutes); total_interview_time_minutes: sum of durations. - interview_completion_rate = completed / total * 100, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when no interviews. - feedback_completion_rate = 100 when any feedback exists else 0, rounded to 2 decimals. - candidate_quality (dept+team): - avg_candidate_experience_score: average overall_candidate_experience_score. - positive_experience_rate = exceptional/excellent experience opportunities / total opportunities * 100, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when no opportunities. - avg_screening_pass_rate: average application_to_screening_rate; high_efficiency_postings: distinct postings with hiring_efficiency_grade=''High Efficiency (≥10%)''. - cost_efficiency (dept+team): - Join dpb to application_volume, hiring_outcomes, and interview_metrics on dept+team; group by dept+team. - total_interview_hours = sum(total_interview_time_minutes) / 60.0. - interview_hours_per_hire = total_interview_hours / total hires, rounded to 1 decimal; NULL when no hires (later COALESCE to 0). - applications_per_hire = sum(total_applications) / total hires, rounded to 1 decimal; NULL when no hires (later COALESCE to 0). - hires_per_posting = total hires / sum(active_postings), rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when no active postings. - cost_efficiency_tier by interview_hours_per_hire: ≤10 Highly Efficient, ≤20 Efficient, ≤40 Moderate Efficiency, >40 Low Efficiency; No Hires when hires=0 (later COALESCE to ''No Data'' if join missing). - Note: dept+team joins cause ho/im to repeat across each application_volume row and posting; sums aggregate repeated rows (scaled by both postings and application_volume rows per dept+team), while ratios dividing repeated sums (e.g., interview_hours_per_hire) cancel the scaling. - Final assembly: - Join department_posting_base to all aggregates on dept+team only, replicating dept+team metrics across each posting’s location/level/commitment slice and across application_volume slices. - Keep rows where application_volume.total_applications>0 OR application_volume.active_postings>0. - Ranks (global across the final set): hiring_volume_rank by candidates_hired DESC, conversion_efficiency_rank by hire_conversion_rate DESC, candidate_experience_rank by avg_candidate_experience_score DESC; ties share rank with gaps. - department_performance_score (0–100, rounded to 0 decimals, clamped): min(25, hires*2.5) + (hire_conversion_rate*0.2) + (interview_completion_rate*0.2) + (positive_experience_rate*0.15) + ([cost_efficiency_tier in {Highly Efficient, Efficient} → 20 else 10]*0.2). - performance_tier: ≥75 Top Performing Department; ≥60 High Performing Department; ≥45 Standard Performing Department; else if total_applications≥10 Underperforming Department; otherwise Low Activity Department. - department_strength priority: referral_rate≥30 → offer_acceptance_rate≥80 → avg_candidate_experience_score≥4.0 → avg_time_to_hire_days≤30 → cost_efficiency_tier in {Highly Efficient, Efficient} → else Standard Operations. - calculated_at = current_timestamp; final output ordered by department_performance_score DESC, then total_applications DESC.'
      columns:
      - name: department
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Department from postings; NULLs replaced with 'Unknown Department'; metrics computed at department+team and replicated across rows
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: team
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Team from postings; NULLs replaced with 'Unknown Team'; metrics computed at department+team and replicated across rows
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: location
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Posting location; NULLs replaced with 'Unknown Location'; slice dimension only (aggregates joined on department+team)
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Posting job level; NULLs replaced with 'Unknown Level'; slice dimension only (aggregates joined on department+team)
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: commitment_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Posting commitment type; NULLs replaced with 'Unknown Commitment'; slice dimension only (aggregates joined on department+team)
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: total_applications
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct application count from application_volume; joined on department+team only; per-row values reflect one application_volume slice; COALESCE to 0
      - name: unique_candidates
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct candidate count from application_volume; joined on department+team only; per-row values reflect one application_volume slice; COALESCE to 0
      - name: active_postings
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct posting count from application_volume; joined on department+team only; per-row values reflect one application_volume slice grouped by time; COALESCE to 0
      - name: avg_applications_per_posting
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Rounded to 1 decimal; total applications divided by active postings from application_volume; 0 when denominator is NULL via COALESCE; joined on department+team only
      - name: referral_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentage with 2 decimals; referred applications divided by total applications *100; 0 when no applications; joined on department+team only
      - name: candidates_hired
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct opportunities marked as hired/accepted (stage contains 'hire' or 'accept') at department+team; replicated across rows; COALESCE to 0
      - name: offers_extended
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct opportunities with offer stages (stage contains 'offer') at department+team; replicated across rows; COALESCE to 0
      - name: hire_conversion_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentage with 2 decimals; candidates_hired divided by distinct opportunities *100 at department+team; 0 when no opportunities; replicated; COALESCE to 0
      - name: offer_acceptance_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentage with 2 decimals; candidates_hired divided by offers_extended *100 at department+team; 0 when no offers; replicated; COALESCE to 0
      - name: avg_time_to_hire_days
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average lifecycle days for hired/accepted opportunities at department+team; NULL→0 via COALESCE; replicated across rows
      - name: avg_interviews_per_hire
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average interview count for hired/accepted opportunities at department+team; NULL→0 via COALESCE; replicated across rows
      - name: total_interviews_conducted
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct interviews at department+team; replicated across rows; COALESCE to 0
      - name: interview_completion_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentage with 2 decimals; completed interviews (not canceled) divided by total interviews *100 at department+team; 0 when no interviews; replicated; COALESCE to 0
      - name: feedback_completion_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentage with 2 decimals; 100 when any feedback exists else 0; replicated across rows; COALESCE to 0
      - name: unique_interviewers
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct interviewer users at department+team; replicated across rows; COALESCE to 0
      - name: avg_interview_duration_minutes
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average interview duration in minutes at department+team; NULL→0 via COALESCE; replicated across rows
      - name: avg_candidate_experience_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average overall candidate experience score at department+team; NULL→0 via COALESCE; replicated across rows
      - name: positive_experience_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percentage with 2 decimals; exceptional/excellent experience opportunities divided by total opportunities *100 at department+team; 0 when no opportunities; replicated; COALESCE to 0
      - name: avg_screening_pass_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average screening pass rate from hiring funnel metrics at department+team; NULL→0 via COALESCE; replicated across rows
      - name: high_efficiency_postings
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct postings with hiring_efficiency_grade='High Efficiency (≥10%)' at department+team; replicated across rows; COALESCE to 0
      - name: interview_hours_per_hire
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Rounded to 1 decimal; total interview hours divided by total hires from cost_efficiency; hires 0→NULL→0 via COALESCE
      - name: applications_per_hire
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Rounded to 1 decimal; total applications divided by total hires from cost_efficiency; hires 0→NULL→0 via COALESCE
      - name: hires_per_posting
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Rounded to 2 decimals; total hires divided by sum of active postings from cost_efficiency; 0 when no active postings; replicated across rows
      - name: cost_efficiency_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Tier by interview_hours_per_hire thresholds (≤10 Highly Efficient, ≤20 Efficient, ≤40 Moderate Efficiency, else Low Efficiency; No Hires when hires=0); COALESCE to 'No Data' if join missing; replicated across rows
      - name: hiring_volume_rank
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Global rank ordered by candidates_hired descending; ties share rank with gaps; replicated across rows for a department+team
      - name: conversion_efficiency_rank
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Global rank ordered by hire_conversion_rate descending; ties share rank with gaps; replicated across rows for a department+team
      - name: candidate_experience_rank
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Global rank ordered by avg_candidate_experience_score descending; ties share rank with gaps; replicated across rows for a department+team

business_logic: '- Build department_posting_base from postings: - Dimensions defaulted via COALESCE: department=''Unknown Department'', team=''Unknown Team'', location=''Unknown Location'', level=''Unknown Level'', commitment_type=''Unknown Commitment''. - Keep posting_id and timestamps; derive posting_month and posting_quarter by truncating created_at. - application_volume (dept+team+location+level+commitment_type+month+quarter): - Distinct counts: applications, candidates, opportunities, postings; referred applications where referrer_user_id is present. - referral_rate = referred applications / total applications * 100, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when no applications. - avg_applications_per_posting = total applications / active postings, rounded to 1 decimal; NULL when active postings=0 (later COALESCE to 0). - hiring_outcomes (dept+team): - candidates_hired: distinct opportunities with stage name containing ''hire'' or ''accept''; offers_extended: distinct opportunities with stage name containing ''offer''. - Averages for hired/accepted only: time_to_hire (lifecycle days) and interviews_per_hire. - hire_conversion_rate = candidates_hired / distinct opportunities * 100, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when no opportunities. - offer_acceptance_rate = candidates_hired / offers_extended * 100, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when no offers. - interview_metrics (dept+team): - total_interviews_conducted: distinct interviews; completed when not canceled; canceled when canceled. - unique_interviewers: distinct interviewer users; avg_interview_duration: average interview duration (minutes); total_interview_time_minutes: sum of durations. - interview_completion_rate = completed / total * 100, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when no interviews. - feedback_completion_rate = 100 when any feedback exists else 0, rounded to 2 decimals. - candidate_quality (dept+team): - avg_candidate_experience_score: average overall_candidate_experience_score. - positive_experience_rate = exceptional/excellent experience opportunities / total opportunities * 100, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when no opportunities. - avg_screening_pass_rate: average application_to_screening_rate; high_efficiency_postings: distinct postings with hiring_efficiency_grade=''High Efficiency (≥10%)''. - cost_efficiency (dept+team): - Join dpb to application_volume, hiring_outcomes, and interview_metrics on dept+team; group by dept+team. - total_interview_hours = sum(total_interview_time_minutes) / 60.0. - interview_hours_per_hire = total_interview_hours / total hires, rounded to 1 decimal; NULL when no hires (later COALESCE to 0). - applications_per_hire = sum(total_applications) / total hires, rounded to 1 decimal; NULL when no hires (later COALESCE to 0). - hires_per_posting = total hires / sum(active_postings), rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when no active postings. - cost_efficiency_tier by interview_hours_per_hire: ≤10 Highly Efficient, ≤20 Efficient, ≤40 Moderate Efficiency, >40 Low Efficiency; No Hires when hires=0 (later COALESCE to ''No Data'' if join missing). - Note: dept+team joins cause ho/im to repeat across each application_volume row and posting; sums aggregate repeated rows (scaled by both postings and application_volume rows per dept+team), while ratios dividing repeated sums (e.g., interview_hours_per_hire) cancel the scaling. - Final assembly: - Join department_posting_base to all aggregates on dept+team only, replicating dept+team metrics across each posting’s location/level/commitment slice and across application_volume slices. - Keep rows where application_volume.total_applications>0 OR application_volume.active_postings>0. - Ranks (global across the final set): hiring_volume_rank by candidates_hired DESC, conversion_efficiency_rank by hire_conversion_rate DESC, candidate_experience_rank by avg_candidate_experience_score DESC; ties share rank with gaps. - department_performance_score (0–100, rounded to 0 decimals, clamped): min(25, hires*2.5) + (hire_conversion_rate*0.2) + (interview_completion_rate*0.2) + (positive_experience_rate*0.15) + ([cost_efficiency_tier in {Highly Efficient, Efficient} → 20 else 10]*0.2). - performance_tier: ≥75 Top Performing Department; ≥60 High Performing Department; ≥45 Standard Performing Department; else if total_applications≥10 Underperforming Department; otherwise Low Activity Department. - department_strength priority: referral_rate≥30 → offer_acceptance_rate≥80 → avg_candidate_experience_score≥4.0 → avg_time_to_hire_days≤30 → cost_efficiency_tier in {Highly Efficient, Efficient} → else Standard Operations. - calculated_at = current_timestamp; final output ordered by department_performance_score DESC, then total_applications DESC.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: lever__hiring_dashboard
      description: Single-row snapshot of executive hiring metrics as of the execution date.
      grain: Exactly one row per execution (single-row snapshot)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_lever__application
      - staging.stg_lever__opportunity
      - staging.stg_lever__stage
      business_logic: '- Snapshot timing: - report_date is set to the system date at query runtime. - generated_at is set to the current timestamp (with time zone) at query runtime. - dashboard_title is the constant string "Executive Hiring Dashboard". - Join path: - Start from all application rows. - Left join opportunities on opportunity_id, then left join stages on stage_id. - Window definition: - “Last 30 days” means on or after 30 calendar days before report_date, inclusive. - Metrics: - Applications in last 30 days: - Count distinct application_id where the application was created within the 30-day window. - Requires a non-null application_id and created_at; each application is counted at most once. - Candidates in last 30 days: - Count distinct candidate_id where the related application was created within the 30-day window. - Requires a non-null candidate_id and created_at; each candidate is counted at most once. - Hires in last 30 days: - Count distinct opportunity_id where the stage name contains the substring "hire" (case-insensitive) and the opportunity’s last advanced time falls within the 30-day window. - Requires both stage name and last advanced time to be present; each opportunity is counted at most once. - Average candidate lifecycle (days): - For each joined row with both timestamps present, compute elapsed days from opportunity created_at to last_interaction_at, then take the simple mean across the application-joined rows. - Fractional days are preserved; no rounding; returns NULL if no qualifying rows. - Opportunities linked to multiple applications contribute once per application due to the chosen join.'
      columns:
      - name: report_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Execution date of the snapshot.
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: generated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Execution timestamp for this snapshot (with time zone).
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: dashboard_title
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Constant title: Executive Hiring Dashboard.'
      - name: applications_last_30_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct applications created in the last 30 days (inclusive) relative to report_date; requires non-null application_id and created_at; 0 if none.
      - name: candidates_last_30_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct candidates with at least one application created in the last 30 days (inclusive); requires non-null candidate_id and created_at; 0 if none.
      - name: hires_last_30_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct opportunities where stage name contains 'hire' (case-insensitive) and last_advanced_at is within the last 30 days (inclusive); requires both fields; 0 if none.
      - name: avg_candidate_lifecycle_days
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Mean days from opportunity created_at to last_interaction_at across joined application rows; only rows with both timestamps; fractional days preserved; NULL if none.

      - intermediate.int_lever__candidate_lifecycle (opportunity_id, total_lifecycle_days, total_stages_passed, feedback_completion_rate_pct)
      - marts.lever__candidate_experience_insights (opportunity_id, overall_candidate_experience_score, experience_grade)
      - staging.stg_lever__interview (interview_id, opportunity_id, canceled_at, duration)
      - staging.stg_lever__interviewer_user (interview_id, user_id)
      - staging.stg_lever__interview_feedback (interview_id, feedback_form_id)
      - intermediate.int_lever__hiring_funnel_metrics (posting_id, avg_days_to_screening, avg_days_screening_to_technical, avg_total_days_to_hire, hiring_efficiency_grade)
      business_logic: '- Define hiring_manager_base: - From users keep access_role in {''admin'',''team_admin'',''limited''}. - Left join requisitions, postings, and applications (via postings) to compute workload: - total_requisitions_owned, total_postings_owned, total_applications_received, total_candidates_managed as distinct counts. - Keep only users with at least one requisition or posting. - Requisition performance per hiring_manager_user_id: - Distinct counts of requisitions by status: open, closed, filled. - avg_salary_range_width = mean of (compensation_band_max - compensation_band_min); NULLs ignored. - unique_teams_hired_for and unique_locations_hired_for as distinct counts. - requisition_fill_rate = filled/total as percent, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when no requisitions. - Posting effectiveness per owner_user_id: - Distinct counts of postings and by state (published, closed). - Averages from posting_performance: avg_applications_per_posting, avg_posting_conversion_rate, avg_posting_performance_score. - high_performing_postings = postings with performance_tier = ''High Performing''; postings_with_no_applications = total_applications = 0. - departments_managed and teams_managed as distinct category counts. - high_performing_posting_rate = high_performing_postings/total as percent, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when no postings. - Candidate management per posting_hiring_manager_user_id: - Distinct counts: total_candidates_managed (opportunities) and total_applications_overseen. - Averages over candidate_lifecycle: avg_candidate_lifecycle_days, avg_stages_per_candidate, avg_interview_completion_rate. - Outcome counts: candidates_hired if stage_name contains ''hire'' or ''accept'' (case-insensitive); offers_extended if contains ''offer''; candidates_rejected if archived_at present. - Candidate experience: average overall_candidate_experience_score; positive_experience_candidates for grades in {''Exceptional Experience'',''Excellent Experience''}. - candidate_hire_rate = candidates_hired/total_candidates_managed as percent, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when none. - Interview coordination per posting_hiring_manager_user_id: - Distinct interviews coordinated; successful if not canceled; canceled if canceled. - Unique interviewers engaged; average interview duration. - Feedback: total_feedback_collected = distinct feedback_form_id; completed_feedback_collected = distinct feedback_form_id. - feedback_completion_rate_managed = distinct non-null feedback_form_id / distinct feedback_form_id as percent, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when none. - interview_success_rate = successful/total as percent, rounded to 2 decimals; 0 when none. - Time efficiency per posting_hiring_manager_user_id (joining funnel metrics via applications, thus weighting postings by application volume): - Averages of avg_days_to_screening, avg_days_screening_to_technical, avg_total_days_to_hire. - high_efficiency_postings = distinct postings with hiring_efficiency_grade = ''High Efficiency (≥10%)''. - decision_speed_category from avg_total_days_to_hire thresholds: <=30 Fast, <=45 Standard, <=60 Deliberate, else Slow. - Final assembly per hiring_manager_id: - Pass identity fields; coalesce numeric metrics to 0 and decision_speed_category to ''Unknown''. - overall_performance_score = rounded (0 decimals), clamped [0,100] sum of: - 0.25*requisition_fill_rate + 0.25*high_performing_posting_rate + 0.25*candidate_hire_rate + 0.15*interview_success_rate - plus time-efficiency bonus based on avg_total_days_to_hire: +10 if <=45 else decreasing by 0.2 per day above 45, floored at 0; if avg_total_days_to_hire is missing, the score is NULL. - performance_tier by score thresholds: >=80 Outstanding; >=65 Effective; >=50 Competent; else Developing if total_candidates_managed>=5, otherwise New/Limited Experience. - hiring_specialization first-match: high_performing_posting_rate>=70 → Job Marketing Expert; else avg_candidate_experience_score>=4.0 → Candidate Experience Specialist; else feedback_completion_rate_managed>=85 → Process Coordinator; else avg_total_days_to_hire<=30 → Fast Decision Maker; else teams_supported>=3 → Multi-Team Recruiter; else Generalist. - development_recommendations = concatenation (in order) of segments with "; " when condition met: requisition_fill_rate<50, avg_applications_per_posting<10, interview_success_rate<80, avg_total_days_to_hire>60; empty string if none. - calculated_at = current query timestamp. - Order output by overall_performance_score descending, then total_candidates_hired descending.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: lever__interview_enhanced
      description: Interview–interviewer–feedback rows inner-joined to opportunity details with derived boolean flags.
      grain: One row per join match between a row in int_lever__interview_users and a row in int_lever__opportunity_users on opportunity_id
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_lever__interview_users
      - intermediate.int_lever__opportunity_users
      business_logic: '- Start with all rows from intermediate.int_lever__interview_users. - Inner join to intermediate.int_lever__opportunity_users on matching opportunity_id; interviews without a match are excluded. If multiple opportunity rows match, one output row is produced for each match. No aggregation, deduplication, or reordering is performed. - Pass through all interview fields unchanged. - Add opportunity attributes: opportunity_owner_name, referrer_name, hiring_manager_name. - Map candidate fields from opportunity: interviewee_name (contact_name), interviewee_location (contact_location), interviewee_origin (origin), interviewee_contact_id (contact_id). - interviewer_is_hiring_manager: set to TRUE when interviewer_name and hiring_manager_name are equal ignoring case; if either value is NULL, set to FALSE; no trimming or other normalization. - has_advanced_since_interview: set to TRUE when opportunity.last_advanced_at is strictly after interview_date; if either timestamp is NULL the result is NULL; no timezone conversion.'
      columns:
      - name: canceled_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Cancellation timestamp from interview_users; NULL if not canceled; pass-through; no timezone conversion
      - name: created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Creation timestamp from interview_users; pass-through; nullable; no timezone conversion
      - name: creator_user_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: User ID who created the interview; pass-through from interview_users; nullable
      - name: interview_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Scheduled interview timestamp from interview_users; pass-through; nullable; used to evaluate the advancement flag
      - name: duration
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Interview duration value from interview_users; pass-through; may be fractional; nullable
      - name: feedback_reminder
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Feedback reminder setting from interview_users; pass-through; nullable
      - name: gcal_event_url
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Google Calendar event URL from interview_users; pass-through; nullable
      - name: interview_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Interview identifier from interview_users; pass-through; expected not NULL in output
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: location
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Interview location from interview_users; pass-through; nullable
      - name: note
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Freeform interview notes from interview_users; pass-through; nullable
      - name: panel_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Panel identifier from interview_users; pass-through; nullable
      - name: stage_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Hiring process stage ID from interview_users; pass-through; nullable
      - name: subject
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Interview subject/title from interview_users; pass-through; nullable
      - name: timezone
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Timezone string from interview_users; pass-through; nullable
      - name: candidate_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Candidate identifier from interview_users; pass-through; nullable
      - name: opportunity_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Opportunity identifier from interview_users; non-null in output due to inner join
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: interviewer_user_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Interviewer user ID from interview_users; pass-through; nullable
      - name: interviewer_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Interviewer full name from interview_users; pass-through; used in hiring-manager comparison; nullable
      - name: interviewer_email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Interviewer email from interview_users; pass-through; nullable
      - name: opportunity_owner_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Opportunity owner name from opportunity_users; pass-through; nullable
      - name: referrer_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Candidate referrer name from opportunity_users; pass-through; nullable
      - name: hiring_manager_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Hiring manager name from opportunity_users; pass-through; nullable
      - name: interviewer_is_hiring_manager
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: TRUE when interviewer_name and hiring_manager_name match ignoring case; FALSE if either is NULL; no trimming or other normalization
      - name: interviewee_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Candidate name from opportunity_users.contact_name; pass-through; nullable
      - name: interviewee_location
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Candidate location from opportunity_users.contact_location; pass-through; nullable
      - name: interviewee_origin
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Candidate origin/source from opportunity_users.origin; pass-through; nullable
      - name: interviewee_contact_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Candidate contact ID from opportunity_users.contact_id; pass-through; nullable
      - name: has_advanced_since_interview
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: TRUE if opportunity.last_advanced_at is after interview_date; NULL if either timestamp is NULL; otherwise FALSE

blocks.original_text:
- name: lever__opportunity_enhanced
      description: Enhanced opportunity records joined with stage name, tags, archive reason, most recent offer, and posting context.
      grain: One row per opportunity_id with a valid stage_id
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_lever__opportunity_contact_info
      - staging.stg_lever__stage
      - staging.stg_lever__archive_reason
      - intermediate.int_lever__opportunity_tags
      - staging.stg_lever__offer
      - staging.stg_lever__posting
      business_logic: '- Use intermediate.int_lever__opportunity_contact_info as the base; each output row represents one opportunity_id from this base. - Inner join staging.stg_lever__stage on stage_id to add current_stage; opportunities without a matching stage are excluded. - Left join staging.stg_lever__archive_reason on archived_reason_id to add archive_reason; if no match, archive_reason is NULL. - Left join intermediate.int_lever__opportunity_tags on opportunity_id to add tags; if no match, tags is NULL. - Determine the most recent offer per candidate by ordering each candidate’s offers by created_at descending and selecting the single most recent record; if multiple offers have the same created_at for a candidate, one is chosen arbitrarily. - Left join this most recent offer to opportunities on opportunity_id; set has_offer to true when a most recent offer exists for this opportunity, otherwise false; set current_offer_status to the joined offer’s status or NULL if no offer joined. - Left join staging.stg_lever__posting on posting_id to add job_title, job_commitment, job_location, job_team, and current_state_of_job_posting; if no match, these fields are NULL. - All other columns are passed through unchanged from the base; NULLs and original values are preserved. No explicit ordering is applied in the result.'
      columns:
      - name: archived_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Timestamp when the opportunity was archived (passthrough from base).
      - name: archived_reason_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Archive reason identifier from the base opportunity record.
      - name: contact_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Candidate contact identifier from the base opportunity record.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Timestamp when the opportunity was created (passthrough from base).
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: is_data_protection_contact_allowed
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Whether contact is allowed under data protection (passthrough from base).
      - name: data_protection_contact_expires_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Expiration timestamp for data protection contact permission (passthrough from base).
      - name: is_data_protection_store_allowed
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Whether data storage is allowed under data protection (passthrough from base).
      - name: data_protection_store_expires_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Expiration timestamp for data protection storage permission (passthrough from base).
      - name: contact_headline
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Professional headline of the contact (passthrough from base).
      - name: opportunity_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Primary key of the opportunity; exactly one output row per value.
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: is_anonymized
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Whether the opportunity data is anonymized (passthrough from base).
      - name: last_advanced_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Timestamp when the opportunity last advanced stages (passthrough from base).
      - name: last_interaction_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Timestamp of the last candidate interaction (passthrough from base).
      - name: contact_location
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Location of the contact (passthrough from base).
      - name: contact_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Full name of the contact (passthrough from base).
      - name: origin
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source/origin of the opportunity (passthrough from base).
      - name: owner_user_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: User ID of the opportunity owner (passthrough from base).
      - name: snoozed_until
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Timestamp until which the opportunity is snoozed (passthrough from base).
      - name: stage_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Stage identifier used to join to stg_lever__stage (inner join key).
      - name: updated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Timestamp when the opportunity was last updated (passthrough from base).
      - name: application_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Associated application identifier (passthrough from base).
      - name: comments
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Free-text comments on the opportunity (passthrough from base).
      - name: company
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Current company of the candidate (passthrough from base).
      - name: posting_hiring_manager_user_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Hiring manager user ID for the posting (passthrough from base).
      - name: posting_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Posting identifier used to join to stg_lever__posting (left join key).
      - name: posting_owner_user_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Posting owner user ID (passthrough from base).
      - name: referrer_user_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: User ID of the referrer (passthrough from base).
      - name: requisition_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Associated requisition identifier (passthrough from base).
      - name: application_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Application type (passthrough from base).
      - name: emails
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Contact email addresses (passthrough from base).
      - name: phones
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Contact phone numbers (passthrough from base).
      - name: linkedin_link
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: LinkedIn profile URL (passthrough from base).
      - name: github_link
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: GitHub profile URL (passthrough from base).
      - name: current_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Stage name joined from stg_lever__stage using stage_id; non-null due to inner join.
      - name: tags
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Tags string from int_lever__opportunity_tags joined on opportunity_id; NULL if no tag record.
      - name: archive_reason
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Archive reason title from stg_lever__archive_reason via archived_reason_id; NULL if no match.
      - name: job_title
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Posting title from stg_lever__posting.posting_title; NULL if no posting match.
      - name: job_commitment
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Posting commitment from stg_lever__posting.categories_commitment; NULL if no posting match.
      - name: job_location
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Posting location from stg_lever__posting.categories_location; NULL if no posting match.
      - name: job_team
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Posting team from stg_lever__posting.categories_team; NULL if no posting match.
      - name: current_state_of_job_posting
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Posting state from stg_lever__posting.state; NULL if no posting match.
      - name: has_offer
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when the candidate’s most recent offer (by created_at) belongs to this opportunity; false otherwise.
      - name: current_offer_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Status of the candidate’s most recent offer joined to this opportunity; NULL if none joined.

blocks.original_text:
- name: lever__opportunity_stage_history
      description: Historical tracking of opportunity stage changes with computed end timestamps and days spent per stage.
      grain: One row per opportunity_id per stage change event (based on updated_at in staging.stg_lever__opportunity_stage_history).
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_lever__opportunity_stage_history
      - staging.stg_lever__stage
      - staging.stg_lever__user
      - marts.lever__opportunity_enhanced
      business_logic: '- Build a chronological stage-change timeline per opportunity from staging.stg_lever__opportunity_stage_history: - valid_from is the stage change timestamp (updated_at). - valid_ending_at is the timestamp of the next stage change within the same opportunity; if there is no later change, use the opportunity archived_at; if still missing, use the current time at query execution. - If multiple events share the same timestamp within an opportunity, the selection of the “next” event follows the database’s default tie handling (no explicit secondary sort). - Join staging.stg_lever__stage (INNER) on stage_id to add the stage name. - Join marts.lever__opportunity_enhanced (INNER) on opportunity_id to add contact, archive details, job fields, and tags. - Left join staging.stg_lever__user on updater_user_id to add updater_user_name (may be null if no matching user). - Compute days_in_stage as the number of calendar days between the dates of valid_from and valid_ending_at; time-of-day is ignored, and results may be zero or negative if dates are out of order. - Output one row per stage change event with all joined attributes and computed metrics; valid_from is stored as a timestamp without time zone, and valid_ending_at as a time zone-aware timestamp.'
      columns:
      - name: opportunity_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique opportunity identifier; present on every row due to inner joins.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: opportunity_contact_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Candidate contact name from the opportunity record.
      - name: valid_from
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Stage start timestamp taken from the stage change event time.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: valid_ending_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Stage end timestamp set to the next stage change time; if none, the opportunity archive time; if still none, the current time at query execution.
      - name: stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Stage name from the stage dimension via inner join on stage_id.
      - name: stage_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Stage identifier from the stage change record used to join the stage name.
      - name: updater_user_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Name of the user who performed the stage update; null if no matching user.
      - name: archive_reason
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Archive reason from the opportunity; null if the opportunity was not archived.
      - name: job_title
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Job title from the opportunity record.
      - name: job_location
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Job location from the opportunity record.
      - name: job_team
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Job team from the opportunity record.
      - name: application_sources
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Application source tags taken from opportunity.tags, preserved as stored.
      - name: days_in_stage
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of calendar days between the dates of valid_from and valid_ending_at; time-of-day ignored.

- name: lever__posting_enhanced
      description: Enhanced job posting facts joined with application metrics, interview counts, requisition stats, tags, and hiring manager name.
      grain: One row per posting_id
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_lever__posting
      - intermediate.int_lever__posting_applications
      - intermediate.int_lever__posting_interviews
      - intermediate.int_lever__posting_tags
      - staging.stg_lever__requisition_posting
      - staging.stg_lever__user
      business_logic: '- Start with all columns from staging.stg_lever__posting; one row per posting_id; these fields are passed through unchanged. - Aggregate requisition-posting links from staging.stg_lever__requisition_posting at posting_id level by counting rows (no deduplication). Left join to add: - count_requisitions = number of requisition links per posting (0 when none). - has_requisition = true when at least one requisition link exists, else false. - Left join intermediate.int_lever__posting_applications on posting_id to add: - first_app_sent_at (NULL when no applications). - count_referred_applications, count_posting_applications, count_manual_user_applications, count_opportunities, count_open_opportunities; each returns 0 when missing. - Left join intermediate.int_lever__posting_interviews on posting_id to add: - count_interviews (0 when missing). - count_interviewees sourced from the intermediate model’s interview coordinator count (0 when missing). - Left join intermediate.int_lever__posting_tags on posting_id to add tags (passthrough string; NULL when no tags). - Left join staging.stg_lever__user using posting_applications.posting_hiring_manager_user_id = user_id to add posting_hiring_manager_name (NULL when no applications or no matching user). - No filtering or sorting is applied; output includes posting.*, the derived counts and flags, tags, and hiring manager name.'

        description: Last update timestamp of the posting; passthrough from the source posting.

        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Employment commitment category; passthrough from the source posting.
      - name: categories_department
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Department category; passthrough from the source posting.
      - name: categories_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Seniority level category; passthrough from the source posting.
      - name: categories_location
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Location category; passthrough from the source posting.

        data_type: VARCHAR
