blocks.original_text:
- name: lever__recruitment_analytics_dashboard
      description: Single-row recruitment analytics summary computed at execution time from applications
      grain: Single row (full-table summary at run time)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_lever__application
      business_logic: '- Produce a single-row summary across all rows in staging.stg_lever__application at query execution time. - report_date: set to the system''s current date at execution. - report_generated_at: set to the system''s current timestamp with time zone at execution. - report_title: fixed text ''Monthly Recruitment Analytics Dashboard''. - total_applications: number of unique application_id values across all rows; NULL application_id does not contribute; duplicates ignored. - total_candidates: number of unique candidate_id values across all rows; NULL candidate_id does not contribute; duplicates ignored. - total_postings: number of unique posting_id values across all rows; NULL posting_id does not contribute; duplicates ignored. - recruitment_health_score: fixed value 100. - recruitment_health_grade: fixed text ''Good''. - No filters, joins, or additional grouping; metrics are computed over the entire source table.'
      columns:
      - name: report_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Current date at execution time; single-row output; non-null and unique
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: report_generated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Current timestamp with time zone at execution time; non-null
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: report_title
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Fixed text 'Monthly Recruitment Analytics Dashboard'
      - name: total_applications
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of unique application_id values across all rows; NULLs excluded; no filtering
      - name: total_candidates
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of unique candidate_id values across all rows; NULLs excluded; no filtering
      - name: total_postings
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of unique posting_id values across all rows; NULLs excluded; no filtering
      - name: recruitment_health_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Fixed value 100
      - name: recruitment_health_grade
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Fixed text 'Good'

blocks.original_text:
- name: lever__requisition_enhanced
      description: Enhanced requisition data combining base requisition/user fields with posting and offer counts and presence flags.
      grain: One row per requisition_id present in intermediate.int_lever__requisition_users
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_lever__requisition_users
      - staging.stg_lever__requisition_posting
      - staging.stg_lever__requisition_offer
      business_logic: '- Use intermediate.int_lever__requisition_users as the base and retain all its rows and columns. - From staging.stg_lever__requisition_posting, aggregate the number of rows per requisition_id; no filtering or deduplication is applied. - From staging.stg_lever__requisition_offer, aggregate the number of rows per requisition_id; no filtering or deduplication is applied. - Join both aggregates to the base on requisition_id, keeping all base rows. - Set count_postings and count_offers to the aggregated counts; when there is no matching aggregate, set the count to 0. - has_posting is true when a posting aggregate exists for the requisition_id, else false; base rows with NULL requisition_id never match and therefore yield false. - has_offer is true when an offer aggregate exists for the requisition_id, else false; base rows with NULL requisition_id never match and therefore yield false.'
      columns:
      - name: created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Timestamp when the requisition was created from the base model.
      - name: creator_user_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: User ID of the requisition creator from the base model.
      - name: hiring_manager_user_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: User ID of the assigned hiring manager from the base model.
      - name: requisition_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique requisition identifier used as the grain and the join key to posting/offer aggregates.
      - name: requisition_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Requisition name or title from the base model.
      - name: owner_user_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: User ID of the requisition owner from the base model.
      - name: status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Current requisition status from the base model.
      - name: backfill
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Indicates whether the requisition is a backfill from the base model.
      - name: compensation_band_currency
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Currency code for the compensation band from the base model.
      - name: compensation_band_interval
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Compensation interval (e.g., annual, hourly) from the base model.
      - name: compensation_band_max
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Maximum compensation value from the base model with no rounding.
      - name: compensation_band_min
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Minimum compensation value from the base model with no rounding.
      - name: employment_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Employment status (e.g., Full-time, Part-time, Contract) from the base model.
      - name: headcount_hired
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Indicates whether the required headcount has been hired from the base model.
      - name: headcount_infinite
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Indicates whether headcount is unlimited from the base model.
      - name: headcount_total
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Boolean headcount flag from the base model.
      - name: internal_notes
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Internal notes for the requisition from the base model.
      - name: location
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Requisition location from the base model.
      - name: requisition_code
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Requisition code or external identifier from the base model.
      - name: team
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Team associated with the requisition from the base model.
      - name: owner_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Display name of the requisition owner from the base model.
      - name: creator_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Display name of the requisition creator from the base model.
      - name: count_postings
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of posting rows for this requisition_id; counts all rows without deduplication or filtering; returns 0 when no match and 0 for base rows with NULL requisition_id.
      - name: has_posting
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when at least one posting row exists for this requisition_id after the join; false otherwise; base NULL requisition_id yields false.
      - name: count_offers
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of offer rows for this requisition_id; counts all rows without deduplication or filtering; returns 0 when no match and 0 for base rows with NULL requisition_id.
      - name: has_offer
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when at least one offer row exists for this requisition_id after the join; false otherwise; base NULL requisition_id yields false.

blocks.original_text:
- name: stg_lever__requisition
      description: "Cleaned job requisitions with validated compensation bands, hiring requirements, and standardized employment classifications"
      source_table: "raw.requisition"
      columns:
        - name: requisition_id
          data_type: VARCHAR(50)
          constraints: [not_null, unique]
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "requisition_id = TRIM(requisition_id)"
              on_failure: correct
            - rule: "LENGTH(TRIM(requisition_id)) > 0"
              on_failure: delete_row
        - name: requisition_code
          data_type: VARCHAR(20)
          constraints: [not_null, unique]
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "requisition_code LIKE 'REQ-%'"
              on_failure: delete_row
        - name: requisition_name
          data_type: VARCHAR(500)
          constraints: [not_null]
        - name: status
          data_type: VARCHAR(20)
          constraints: [not_null]
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "status IN ('open', 'closed', 'cancelled', 'draft', 'pending')"
              on_failure: delete_row
        - name: employment_status
          data_type: VARCHAR(20)
          constraints: [not_null]
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "employment_status IN ('full-time', 'part-time', 'contract', 'internship', 'temporary')"
              on_failure: delete_row
        - name: compensation_band_currency
          data_type: VARCHAR(3)
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "compensation_band_currency IS NULL OR compensation_band_currency IN ('USD', 'EUR', 'GBP', 'CNY', 'CAD', 'AUD')"
              on_failure: nullify_field
        - name: compensation_band_interval
          data_type: VARCHAR(10)
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "compensation_band_interval IS NULL OR compensation_band_interval IN ('hourly', 'monthly', 'yearly')"
              on_failure: nullify_field
        - name: compensation_band_min
          data_type: DOUBLE
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "compensation_band_min IS NULL OR compensation_band_min >= 0"
              on_failure: nullify_field
        - name: compensation_band_max
          data_type: DOUBLE
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "compensation_band_max IS NULL OR compensation_band_max >= compensation_band_min"
              on_failure: nullify_field
        - name: location
          data_type: VARCHAR(255)
        - name: team
          data_type: VARCHAR(255)
        - name: creator_user_id
          data_type: VARCHAR(50)
          constraints: [not_null]
        - name: owner_user_id
          data_type: VARCHAR(50)
          constraints: [not_null]
        - name: hiring_manager_user_id
          data_type: VARCHAR(50)
        - name: created_at
          data_type: TIMESTAMP
        - name: backfill
          data_type: BOOLEAN
          constraints: [not_null]
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "backfill IN (TRUE, FALSE)"
              on_failure: delete_row
        - name: headcount_hired
          data_type: INT
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "headcount_hired IS NULL OR headcount_hired >= 0"
              on_failure: nullify_field
            - rule: "headcount_total IS NULL OR headcount_hired <= headcount_total"
              on_failure: nullify_field
        - name: headcount_infinite
          data_type: BOOLEAN
        - name: headcount_total
          data_type: INT
          validation_rules:
            - rule: "headcount_total IS NULL OR headcount_total >= 0"
              on_failure: nullify_field
            - rule: "headcount_infinite IS FALSE OR headcount_total IS NULL"
              on_failure: nullify_field
        - name: internal_notes
          data_type: VARCHAR(1000)
